name: B10-0223/2025 (ECR) – Immediate risk of further repression by Lukashenka’s regime in Belarus - threats from the Investigative Committee
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the immediate risk of further repression by Lukashenka’s regime in Belarus – threats from the Investigative Committee
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of three imprisoned Belarusian women and of journalist Andrzej Poczobut. It condemns Belarus charging people abroad for peaceful pro-democracy activity. It asks the European Union to sanction officials of the Belarusian Investigative Committee, urges the International Criminal Court to act faster, and asks European Union countries to make life easier for Belarusians in exile. The text is an opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a request for sanctions, releases and faster court action.
- **Who it affects:** Imprisoned Belarusians, Belarusian exiles in the European Union, and Belarusian officials.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the European Union's foreign policy chief, the Council and Belarusian representatives.
